user_story: As a devotee I want to subscribe to a Panchangam calendar feed for my city so Tithi/Nakshatra appear in my calendar
As a devotee I want to receive an alert the evening before Ekadashi so I can prepare for my fast
As a devotee I want to receive alerts before Amavasya / Pournami / Pradosham / Shani Pradosham
As a devotee I want to see Rahu Kalam and other inauspicious windows as calendar blocks with 15-minute advance reminders
As a devotee I want to see Brahma Muhurta / Abhijit Muhurta / Amrita Kalam as auspicious calendar blocks
As a devotee I want to see Varjyam / Durmuhurtham / Choghadiya blocks in my calendar
As a devotee I want to see the full day metadata (Samvatsara / Maasam / Paksham / Vaaram) visible in the all-day event
As a devotee I want to pick my city and calculation system on a landing page and get my webcal subscription URL
As a scholar or priest I want to choose Surya Siddhanta or Vakya system for ritual-accurate timings
As a maintainer I want feeds regenerated automatically each month without any manual intervention
